insight: Backed by Andreessen Horowitz at pre-seed; gives agents licensed access to paywalled sources — academic papers, filings and patents.
name: Valyu
tagline: Real-time search and deep research API for AI agents.
description: Valyu is a search and retrieval API built for AI agents and LLMs. Its DeepSearch returns full extracted, structured content — not just links — from the open web plus proprietary and paywalled sources like academic papers, regulatory filings, patents, and financial data. A separate DeepResearch API runs asynchronous, multi-step research across those sources and synthesizes the results into reports and structured data.

modelSupport.notes: Search/retrieval API; plugs into any agent or LLM stack.

edge: Returns structured, extracted content from licensed paywalled papers, filings and patents — not just links most search APIs stop at.
pros: Full extracted content, ready for RAG
Deep research API for multi-step tasks
